name: Colossae

related_people.name: Archippus
related_people.role: charged through the church here to complete the ministry he had received

related_people.name: Epaphras
related_people.role: a native of this city, who first brought it the gospel and prayed hard for it

related_people.name: Onesimus
related_people.role: the runaway slave of this city, sent back with Paul's letter to Philemon

related_people.name: Philemon
related_people.role: a believer of this city to whom Paul wrote about his slave Onesimus

description: A city in the Lycus Valley of Asia Minor, home to a church Paul had not personally founded or visited but wrote to (via Epaphras's report) to combat false teaching that diminished Christ's supremacy (Colossians 1:2, 7; 2:8-23). Philemon and the runaway slave Onesimus, addressed in Paul's shortest letter, were also from Colossae.
family_friendly_summary: Colossae was a city with a church that Paul had never actually visited. When he heard that false teachers there were making Jesus seem less important than He really is, Paul wrote the letter of Colossians to remind them that Jesus is above everything. Philemon and Onesimus also came from Colossae.
